name: Amrit Palace
mood: Spiced parchment gallery with candlelit dining photography, sparse saffron punctuation, sharp geometry, and whisper-weight serif headings.

parchment.role: Page canvas and primary card surfaces.

linen.role: Secondary section tone and subtle surface layering.

walnut.role: Muted helper text, captions, and metadata.

espresso.role: Secondary body text and subhead copy.

onyxWarm.role: Primary text, navigation, headings, and dark fills.

midnightRoast.role: Deep dark overlay for hero and atmospheric photography.

saffronGlow.role: Sole chromatic accent for stars, active states, featured tags, and decorative punctuation.

fallbacks.display: Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, DM Serif Display, serif
fallbacks.body: Inter, DM Sans, Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif

rules: Use TT Ramillas Variable for all display and section headings.
Use uppercase and tight negative tracking on headings 50px and above.
Use Satoshi for nav, body, buttons, labels, and captions.
Do not use pure black text.

components.name: Ghost Outlined Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px context border, Satoshi 14px/500 uppercase, 3px radius, generous padding, no shadow.

components.name: Text Link Button
components.recipe: Satoshi 13-15px uppercase text-only link, underline on hover, no background or border.

components.name: Hero Wordmark Display
components.recipe: Satoshi 199px/500 uppercase, line-height 0.8, tight tracking, Parchment text over dark photo.

components.name: Editorial Section Heading
components.recipe: TT Ramillas Variable 50-115px, weight 300, uppercase, tight tracking, compressed line height.

components.name: Testimonial Card
components.recipe: Parchment surface, 0px radius, no border, no shadow, saffron stars, Satoshi body, Walnut author.

components.name: Image Overlay Container
components.recipe: Full-viewport photo with dark Midnight Roast overlay and Parchment text.

components.name: Star Rating Display
components.recipe: Five Saffron stars, Satoshi score, compact source label, optional floating widget.

components.name: Menu Item Card
components.recipe: Transparent sharp container, food image, dish name, compact description, 16px internal spacing.

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.recipe: Transparent over hero, Satoshi uppercase links, small logo, right-side action links and square 3px icon buttons.

components.name: Section Divider Rule
components.recipe: 1px Warm Stone horizontal rule across section.

components.name: Caption Label
components.recipe: Satoshi 12-13px/500 uppercase with tight negative tracking.

do: Use TT Ramillas Variable at weight 300 for section headings.
Use uppercase tight tracking on headings 50px and above.
Use Saffron Glow only 2-3 times per fold.
Keep cards, sections, and images at 0px radius.
Use 3px radius only for buttons, tags, and controls.
Use Warm Stone 1px dividers as editorial rules.
Lead with dark full-bleed photography, then shift into parchment content.
Keep body copy at 13px to 16px Satoshi.
dont: Do not add shadows or elevation.
Do not introduce a second chromatic accent.
Do not use filled chromatic buttons.
Do not use pure black for text.
Do not add gradients; atmosphere comes from photography.
Do not bold the TT Ramillas serif headings.

imagery.style: Dark, warm, candlelit restaurant interiors and editorial food still-lifes.
rules: Use full-bleed atmospheric photography in the hero.
Use table-height dining interiors and food in sharp focus.
Keep imagery warm, dim, and slightly cinematic.

layout.structure: Full-bleed sections with parchment editorial spreads and dark photographic bookends.
layout.navigation: Transparent floating nav over hero, no background bar.
layout.sectionRhythm: 120px to 160px section gaps, left-aligned editorial columns, horizontal testimonial rows.
